transcript: What if an app started tracking you without permission? You find a strange app on your phone. You never downloaded it. No icon. No name. Just a blank screen. A notification pops up. We see you. You check your camera. Your microphone. Nothing is on. Another message. You don't look behind you. Your breathing stops. The lights flicker. A chill runs down your spine. You try deleting the app, but the screen freezes. Another message. It's too late. Your phone rings. Unknown number. You answer. But there's no sound, just breathing. Then one final message, we're here. Would you smash the phone or see what happens next? Let me know in the comments. Like, share and subscribe for more terrifying horror shorts.
